mapper.sql: SELECT CAST(p.GUID AS varchar(36)) AS guid, p.[No] AS productCode, LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(p.Barcode, ''))) AS barcode, COALESCE( NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.[Name])), ''), NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.NameP)), '') ) AS supplierName, p.NameP AS nameForeign, p.[Name] AS nameChinese, p.QuantityBk AS quantity, p.PurchasePrice AS purchasePrice, p.PurchasePriceTax AS purchasePriceTax, p.TaxRate AS taxRate, p.RetailPriceTax AS retailPrice FROM dbo.Products p LEFT JOIN dbo.Suppliers s ON s.GUID = p.DefaultSupplierGUID
WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(p.Barcode, ''))) <> '' AND (p.RetailPriceTax IS NULL OR p.RetailPriceTax = 0) AND (p.IsDisabled = 0 OR p.IsDisabled IS NULL)
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM #RetailPriceRefBarcodes ref WHERE ref.barcode = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(p.Barcode, ''))) )
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM #RetailPriceRefBarcodes ref WHERE ref.barcode = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(p.Barcode, ''))) )
